buttons.label: 重启
buttons.script:
--lua
local RELAY = 'relay1'
local CH = 1
local OFF_SEC = 1.2
print('REBOOT: power off ' .. OFF_SEC .. 's')
relay_mode(RELAY, CH, 'hold_off', 0)
sleep(OFF_SEC)
relay_mode(RELAY, CH, 'hold_on', 0)
print('REBOOT: power on')

buttons.label: 进U-Boot
buttons.script:
--lua
local RELAY = 'relay1'
local CH = 1
local OFF_SEC = 1.2
print('UBOOT: power off ' .. OFF_SEC .. 's')
relay_mode(RELAY, CH, 'hold_off', 0)
sleep(OFF_SEC)
local mark = channel.mark()
print('UBOOT: power on, hammering Ctrl+C + Space')
relay_mode(RELAY, CH, 'hold_on', 0)
local out = ''
local hit = false
for i = 1, 360 do
  channel.send('<ctrl+c>')
  channel.send('<space>')
  local d = channel.read_since(mark)
  if d and #d > 0 then out = d end
  local lo = string.lower(out)
  if string.find(lo, 'u-boot', 1, true) or string.find(out, '=>', 1, true) then
    hit = true
    break
  end
  msleep(40)
end
local tail = channel.wait_idle(mark, 250, 2) or ''
if #tail > 0 then out = tail end
if #out > 0 then print(out) end
if hit then
  print('UBOOT: entered')
else
  print('UBOOT: no U-Boot prompt seen')
end

buttons.label: 自动登录
buttons.script:
--lua
local RELAY = 'relay1'
local CH = 1
local USER = 'root'
local PASS = 'YOUR_PASSWORD'

local function boot()
  relay_mode(RELAY, CH, 'hold_off', 0)
  sleep(1.2)
  relay_mode(RELAY, CH, 'hold_on', 0)
end

boot()
local m = channel.mark()
local text, why = channel.wait_mark(m, 'login:', 30)
if not text then
  channel.send('<enter>')
  local m0 = channel.mark()
  msleep(400)
  local probe = channel.wait_idle(m0, 300, 4) or ''
  if probe:find('root@') or probe:find('#') then
    print('AUTO_LOGIN: already at shell')
    return
  end
  error('AUTO_LOGIN: 30 秒内没有出现 login:')
end
print('AUTO_LOGIN: 检测到 login 提示')
channel.write(USER .. '\r\n')
local mp = channel.mark()
local ptxt = channel.wait_mark(mp, 'assword:', 12)
if not ptxt then error('AUTO_LOGIN: 输入 root 后没有出现 password:') end
channel.write(PASS .. '\r\n')
local m1 = channel.mark()
local out = channel.wait_idle(m1, 350, 8) or ''
print(out)
local low = out:lower()
local bad = low:find('incorrect') or low:find('denied') or low:find('failure') or low:find('invalid')
if bad then
  print('AUTO_LOGIN: 第一次密码被拒绝，等待密码提示后重试')
  local m2 = channel.mark()
  local again = channel.wait_mark(m2, 'assword:', 6)
  if not again then
    channel.send('<enter>')
    again = channel.wait_mark(channel.mark(), 'assword:', 5)
  end
  if not again then error('AUTO_LOGIN: 重试前没有再次出现 password:') end
  channel.write(PASS .. '\r\n')
  local m3 = channel.mark()
  local out2 = channel.wait_idle(m3, 350, 8) or ''
  print(out2)
  local low2 = out2:lower()
  if low2:find('incorrect') or low2:find('denied') or low2:find('failure') then
    error('AUTO_LOGIN: 重试后仍登录失败')
  end
end
if low:find('root@') or low:find('#') then
  print('AUTO_LOGIN: 已登录')
else
  print('AUTO_LOGIN: 命令已发送，未明确识别到 shell 提示符')
end
